comments.author: Zephyroam
comments.body:
Hi @weiyinfu, thanks for reporting this issue!

The root cause is that tiktoken 0.7.x does not provide pre-built wheels for Python 3.13, so pip attempts to compile it from source, which requires a Rust compiler.

Workarounds:
1. Downgrade to Python 3.12 - tiktoken 0.7.0 has pre-built wheels for Python 3.12, so installation should work without compilation.
2. Install the Rust compiler 
 
Then restart your terminal and retry pip install camel-ai.
